# Shen Ting Ang

> Personal website of Shen Ting Ang, Senior Consultant, Data Scientist at Thoughtworks Singapore. Writes about data science, AI, bridge, and technology.

## About

- [About Shen Ting](https://shenting.org/about/): Senior Consultant, Data Scientist at Thoughtworks Singapore. Background in data science, Masters in Computer Science from UC San Diego, BSc/Masters in MORSE from the University of Warwick. Previously Competition Secretary of the Singapore Contract Bridge Association; APBF International Tournament Director since 2024.

## AI and Machine Learning

- [Good Governance Is Good Design](https://shenting.org/post/ai_governance/): On AI governance frameworks — ISO 42001 and NIST AI RMF — and how good governance is fundamentally a design problem.
- [A Year of Coding with AI](https://shenting.org/post/ai_coding_retrospective/): Retrospective on a year of AI-assisted software development — what changed, what didn't, and what it means for the craft.
- [5 Hazards Attitudes of Adopting AI](https://shenting.org/post/five_hazards/): Five cognitive hazard attitudes that organisations bring to AI adoption, adapted from aviation psychology.

## Data Science

- [Organizing Data Science Projects](https://shenting.org/post/organizing_ds_projects/): Practical structure for keeping data science projects maintainable and reproducible.
- [Mandatory Reading on Names](https://shenting.org/post/names/): Why names are harder than they look — and what that means for data systems.
- [Why you probably shouldn't outsource data work](https://shenting.org/post/outsource_data_work/): The case for keeping data work in-house and why outsourcing it often backfires.
- [Visualizations at Meetings](https://shenting.org/post/visualizations/): How to use data visualisations effectively in meetings, not just as decoration.
- [You Should not be Using Anaconda](https://shenting.org/post/anaconda/): Why Anaconda is the wrong default for Python environments and what to use instead.
- [DataScience SG Talk: Data Challenges](https://shenting.org/post/datachallenges/): Talk given at DataScience SG on common data challenges faced by practitioners.
- [DataScience SG Talk on Sample Count and Podcast](https://shenting.org/post/podcast_dssg/): Companion post to a podcast episode on sample counts and data reliability.
- [How Much Should You Trust the Sample Count? (Part 1)](https://shenting.org/post/sample_count_1/): Statistical intuition on when sample counts are and aren't trustworthy.
- [How Much Should You Trust the Sample Count? (Part 2)](https://shenting.org/post/sample_count_2/): Continuation of the sample count series.
- [MRT Challenge](https://shenting.org/post/mrt_challenge/): A data challenge built around Singapore's MRT transit network.
- [RPA Career Talk](https://shenting.org/post/rpa_career_talk/): Notes from a career talk on robotic process automation and data science careers.

## Rating Systems

- [Rating Systems (1): Elo and its limitations](https://shenting.org/post/rating_1_elo/): Introduction to Elo ratings — how they work and where they fall short.
- [Rating Systems (2): Glicko-2](https://shenting.org/post/rating_2_glicko/): Glicko-2 as a solution to Elo's limitations, with rating deviation and volatility.
- [Rating Systems (3): TrueSkill — Multiplayer Ratings](https://shenting.org/post/rating_3_trueskill/): TrueSkill and Bayesian approaches to rating players in multiplayer settings.
- [SCBA Ratings — Now Live](https://shenting.org/post/scba_rating_live/): Announcement of the Singapore Contract Bridge Association live ratings system.

## Ethereum and Web3

- [ETH Node Part 1: Raspberry Pi 4](https://shenting.org/post/eth_node_1/): Setting up an Ethereum node on a Raspberry Pi 4.
- [ETH Node Part 2: 64 Bit Ubuntu](https://shenting.org/post/eth_node_2/): Moving the ETH node to 64-bit Ubuntu for better compatibility.
- [ETH Node Part 3: Block Sync](https://shenting.org/post/eth_node_3/): Getting the Ethereum node fully synced to the chain.

## Personal and Miscellaneous

- [2025 in Review](https://shenting.org/post/2025_in_review/): Personal year-in-review for 2025.
- [The worst day of my life...](https://shenting.org/post/worst_day_of_my_life/): A personal essay.
- [Fracture](https://shenting.org/post/fracture/): A personal essay.
- [The Great Gatsby: 100 Years Later](https://shenting.org/post/thegreatgatsby/): Reflections on re-reading The Great Gatsby a century after publication.
- [P.I.O.S.E.E](https://shenting.org/post/piosee/): On the PIOSEE problem-solving framework from aviation, applied broadly.
- [On Mentorship](https://shenting.org/post/mentorship/): Thoughts on what good mentorship looks like and what it isn't.
